## Checklist

- [ ] The documentation in `docs/` is updated, or no public behavior (API, plugin contract, procedure, dashboard behavior) changes.
- [ ] The comments, the file headers and the documentation are written in English. Texts shown to the user are in the translation catalogs.
- [ ] Every new control uses a component of Home Assistant, or is a fallback or an exception with its comment (see the code conventions).
- [ ] `npm run check` and the tests (`npm test`, `pytest`) pass.
